Project Subtitle Evidence Library preserves raw subtitle payloads without translation/normalization/retiming/rewriting.
Project documentation explicitly warns that .tc/script branch does not prove Taiwan origin, official localization, or dub wording.
Project archive records at least one old movie with separate Taiwan Mandarin [哆啦A梦版] and [小叮当版] audio-track identities.
Project workbook records a 2026 Taiwan redub set described as a modern 哆啦A梦 Mandarin redub branch.
For dub-faithful subtitles, audible dub wording is preserved and outranks a modern series glossary; track labels alone do not prove every spoken line.
Project output requirement: Taiwan Mandarin dub subtitles must preserve the dub wording but render the transcript in Simplified Chinese script rather than Traditional Chinese.
Movie-specific entities and remakes are title-scoped; narrower branch/title scope overrides series defaults.
Historical names are retained as deprecated input aliases rather than forbidden strings so archival/dub material remains intelligible.
